description: Rural Utilities Alberta Low Pressure Gas Distribution is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta. This dataset is provided by the Ministry of Utilities and Affordability, Rural Utilities Branch, and represents rural low-pressure pipelines (less than 700 kPa) and customer meters in Alberta that are under the jurisdiction of the Gas Distribution Act, including Gas Co-operatives, First Nations, Municipalities and Counties, Private Systems, Apex Utilities Inc., and ATCO Gas Inc. Coverage: Government of Alberta. The portal files it under the publisher Government of Alberta | Gouvernement de l'Alberta. Its tags are -CANADA, ALBERTA, ALDER-FLATS, ANKERTON, APEX-UTILITIES-INC-. It offers 7 resource(s) in ESRI REST, HTML, XML, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-08-26 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Alberta. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
